## ProgressCircular.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: Current progress value, or `null`/`undefined` for indeterminate spinner motion.
- `min` :: Lower bound of the range.
- `max` :: Upper bound of the range.
- `tone` :: Semantic color tone.
- `size` :: Outer ring diameter on the shared size ladder.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the percentage readout.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the readout. Defaults to `text-secondary`.
- `showValue` :: Render percentage text in the ring center when `children` is omitted.
- `label` :: Accessible label naming the progress indicator.
- `children` :: Custom center content inside the ring.
